headline: South Sudan's $50 e-visa fee threatens East African labour mobility

story_facts.headline: South Sudan's $50 e-visa fee threatens East African labour mobility
story_facts.plain_language_summary: Under the revised charges, published on the country's electronic visa portal on Monday, Somali and Burundian citizens will pay $100 to enter South Sudan.
